description: This file contains CSS styles for managing themes (light and dark) and general styling for the App component in the frontend of a quotes management application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class that handles the overall layout and theme-dependent styles.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application, styled to accommodate logo and navigation.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link styles within the application, tailored for themed appearance.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button class designed for toggling between themes with an interactive design.
